title: Behold the Son
headline: Is Jesus Becoming More Beautiful to You, or Just More Useful?
tagline: Christ is not merely the pathway to the treasure. Christ is the Treasure.
seo_title: Is Jesus Your Treasure or Just Your Tool? (Colossians 1:15) | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Christianity doesn't only say stop looking at lesser things. It says look at Christ. A devotional for men on John 1:14, Colossians 1:15 and Hebrews 1:3.
verse_text: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.

scriptures.text: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
The Son is the radiance of God’s glory and the exact representation of his being….
The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory….

items: Yesterday we asked, “What are you beholding?”

blocks.text: Who is worthy of your gaze?

items: Christianity doesn’t merely tell you, “Stop looking at lesser things.”
Not merely as a solution to your problems.

sections.label: The Invisible God Has Made Himself Known

items: When we want to know what God is like, Christianity doesn’t leave us with speculation.

blocks.text: “Jesus is most valuable because of what He can do for me.”

items: This lie can hide inside Christianity.
Jesus becomes the One who fixes my marriage, helps my business, heals my pain, opens opportunities.
He does care about those things.
But if He is only valuable for what He provides, He has become useful rather than beautiful.
I want more than a better life.
Can Christ contradict me and remain Christ to me?
Diagnosis must eventually give way to adoration.
Is Jesus becoming more beautiful to me, or merely more useful?
Return not merely to a principle. Return to a Person.
